probes.question: One teaspoon of neutron star material would have a mass about how many times that of the Great Pyramid of Giza?
True or false: the Earth at neutron star density would fit into a sphere about the size of the Arecibo Telescope.

image.alt: Artist's rendering of a tiny, bright neutron star at the centre of a glowing red accretion disk against a dense starfield.

body.question: If the entire mass of the Earth had neutron star density, it would fit into a sphere how many metres in diameter?
body.reveal: The entire mass of the Earth at neutron star density would fit into a sphere 305 m in diameter, about the size of the Arecibo Telescope.
